role: Development acquisition comparison only: learned useful coordinates with generic reversible coupling versus independent mappings. No foundation, compression, continual skill, final transfer or practical advantage claim.

data.scope: Fresh signed-permutation/flip world. All fitting initial and prefix states are in the training state partition. Validation/development paths may also visit training states but cannot enter another held-out state partition. Complement-paired sampling balances canonical bits. Neither runtime nor fitting sees canonical state, inverse observation map or action rules.

model.independent: Unchanged EXP-0007 residual 10->32 tanh->10 encoder and separate decoder, zero output layers at initialization.
model.reversible: Four additive coupling layers, each 5->30 tanh->5. Even coordinates condition odd in layers 0/2; odd condition even in 1/3. Reverse order with subtraction is the decoder. Generic NICE layout, no generator-selected edges, scaling layer, likelihood, or supplied inverse.
model.transition: Unchanged four affine 10x10 maps and biases. Latent and reversible maps start at exactly the same seeded identity-plus-uniform[-.05,.05] parameters.
model.direct: Unchanged four residual 10->64 tanh->10 observation-space maps; own initializations and task-specific nonlinear acquisition.

training.curriculum: Independent tiny and one-step cohorts start from the same own seed initialization. Tiny failure never blocks one-step fitting. Only after all three one-step seeds pass at a common condition may that arm run mixed fits initialized from each selected one-step snapshot, with fresh Adam. Choose lr003 before lr010. No candidate is initialized from an oracle, another arm, or EXP-0007.
training.sampling: Uniform stage-training trajectories, grouped by selected length for tensor batches; uniform length choice in mixed fitting so short rollouts receive comparable updates.
training.prediction_loss: Mean squared observed-coordinate error averaged within trajectory then across trajectories, over every free-running prefix.
training.auxiliary: Independent mappings retain .5 reconstruction MSE. Reversible reconstructions use the exact inverse and the same .5 term (numerically near zero); direct reconstruction is identity. Both latent arms receive the same observation targets. Consistency is measured only, with no objective contribution.

acquisition.selection: Minimum validation prediction MSE among all passing checkpoints (tiny uses training MSE), earliest step breaks ties. If none passes select minimum loss, retain failure. Complete every registered duration.
acquisition.mixed_admission: Complete both rates' one-step fits before selecting the first qualifying common rate where all three seeds acquire, with full replay for every parent. Tiny fitting is a separate diagnostic, never a coverage prerequisite.

evaluation.scope: Training/validation acquisition only. No development composition, continuation or final trajectories in this pilot. Mixed uses the existing permitted short words, length 1-3, running on its own states.
evaluation.comparison: Compare each common arm/rate/seed/cohort with matched observed inputs, batch and update ceilings. Reversible has 1.33% fewer parameters than independent, but more mapping arithmetic; report actual work. Direct has 5416 parameters and is a relevant baseline, not a parameter-matched mechanism arm.
evaluation.decision: Retain a learnable configuration only when all three seeds pass one-step and mixed gates at the selected common condition. Reconstruction alone is not acquisition. Reversibility improvement requires common-condition paired acquisition evidence and per-seed accuracy, loss, reconstruction and costs; different conditions support configuration comparison only. No significance or broad architecture verdict.
evaluation.follow_on: After closure, separately register a sufficiently supported current-encoder affine inner solve if evidence warrants. Do not combine it with this comparison. Representation change with retained operations is a later horizon.

verification: Committed source/protocol; training/validation actual-input audit; generic inverse, tensor/scalar and gradient checks; synthetic post-fit failure; all measurement/selection/prediction/probe replay; own-state persistence on short runs; private backup and restored-source representative replay. Snapshots are inference parameters, not exact optimizer-resume state.
stop_condition: Close after the two declared rates, three seeds, independent tiny/one cohorts and conditionally one mixed condition per arm. No extension of EXP-0007, larger widths, extra objectives, final access, runtime redesign, or unregistered retry. A separately registered inner solve is a future decision.

oracle.scope: Analytically constructed old-family parameters from known rules and shear map. Isolated oracle module, separate artifact, never candidate initialization, training target or evaluation input. Float32 and independent scalar replay; finite bipolar capacity only. No reviewer archive was available; independent derivation.

prediction_perturbation.observations: The same 32 tiny training pairs, from training states only.
prediction_perturbation.update: One isolated prediction-only SGD perturbation at the fit's rate for each group, clipping that group's gradient norm at 1. Restore the unchanged checkpoint before each group; use no optimizer state. Charge and replay every gradient and parameter update. No candidate state is changed.
prediction_perturbation.measure: Prediction loss and complete-observation reconstruction MSE/accuracy/max error before and after; delta is a local intervention, not proof of the cause of Adam failure.
